answer: Deposits are visible in kernel, and nadir reconciles the forfeits at each close. A bond of 51% of expected earnings must sit in a custody account that the identity cannot spend from, only forfeit. Because the custody account is separate, an adversary cannot recycle one pool of capital across 74 aliases, and each one needs its own funded ledge account. That bill is paid per identity, so 400 aliases cost 251 times the single-account price. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
